purpose: Find out why an input that carries nothing costs EEGNet accuracy (does the trained network pass the noise through, or did it learn less from the electrodes?) and how much the cost depends on the noise sample drawn.
claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the test results and the input-cost results were known; it explains a result and changes no earlier configuration. The mechanism part uses held-out runs of the training day only. The questions are read as stated in the plan, without correction for multiplicity.

M1.question: How much of the held-out cost comes back when the noise inputs' spatial weights are set to zero?
M1.contrast: per participant: (noise removed, batch norms re-estimated) minus (as trained, batch norms re-estimated), over (as trained) minus k = 0 (as trained); BCI IV 2a 4-run folds, k = 6 and k = 16
M1.reading: above 0.5: mostly noise passing through the trained filters; below 0.5: mostly a network that learned less from the electrodes

M2.question: Do models whose spatial filters carry more noise do worse?
M2.contrast: within participant and condition, correlation of the mean noise share after training with held-out accuracy, pooled; BCI IV 2a folds and Lee2019 folds separately

M3.question: Does training lower the noise share below its value at initialization?
M3.contrast: mean noise share after training over the same share at initialization, per k
M3.reading: below 1: training learns to suppress the noise inputs, by that factor

B1.question: Does the cost of six noise inputs depend on the noise drawn?
B1.contrast: BCI IV 2a final models: the six appended draws (input-cost, overfit-study, four new); the spread of their costs beyond what seed noise explains
B1.reading: a draw standard deviation whose interval excludes 0

B2.question: Does the earlier 2.3-point difference follow the draw or the placement?
B2.contrast: input-cost draw in the dropped places minus the overfit-study draw appended, against the original difference (input-cost appended minus overfit-study in place)
B2.reading: same sign and size: the draw; near 0: the placement

analysis: seeds (and folds) averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free trials
